Right, everybody, quick one before we go out. We have a new member today. This is Renato. He is from Brazil and he surfs comps back home, so no pressure, mate. Welcome to the Scarborough High boardriders. We train on Tuesday and Thursday after school, and on Saturday at six in the morning if the swell is good. Nobody enjoys getting up at half past five, but everybody loves being first in the water. A few rules. We don't mind helping new people, but you have to ask. Nobody here likes waiting for somebody who is late, so be on the sand by a quarter past four. And in the water we share waves. If you love dropping in on people, this is the wrong club. After training we usually hang out at the kiosk and get chips. You don't have to come, but you should. That is where you actually meet everybody. Okay. Let's go.

Hey, it's Millie. Mum said you are going to the surf club today, so here is the cheat sheet, because you are going to forget everybody's name. Kai is the captain. He is nice, but he can't stand people being late, so don't be late. Jess is the one with the pink board. She loves talking, so if you are shy, stand next to her and you won't have to say anything. Tom and Ollie are twins and they always argue. Don't pick a side. And Harper is really quiet at first, but she is actually the best surfer there. She enjoys watching new people before she talks to them, so don't take it personally. Oh, and one more thing. Everybody hates the cold water in the morning. If you want to break the ice, complain about the water. It works every time. Good luck.
